change_description: Strategic pivot: MeetUniversity is pivoting focus to German public universities, tuition-free education counseling, blocked accounts, and German student visa requirements (APS certificate and TestAS), expanding operations into Berlin and Munich.

competitors_removed.name: Shorelight
competitors_removed.reason: Shorelight is hyper-focused on the US higher education market and university partnerships. As MeetUniversity pivots exclusively to German public universities and tuition-free education, Shorelight's US-centric model is no longer a relevant competitive benchmark.

competitors_removed.name: Unibuddy
competitors_removed.reason: Unibuddy is a B2B SaaS platform focused on student engagement and peer-to-peer marketing for universities. It does not provide the specialized visa, blocked account, and APS certificate counseling services that define MeetUniversity's new niche focus.

competitors_added.name: Expatrio
competitors_added.reason: Discovered and verified via live website audit: Expatrio provides essential financial and insurance services (Blocked Accounts, health insurance) required by international students to secure visas for study abroad, which is a critical post-admissions step for the same customer segment targeted by MeetUniversity.
competitors_added.evidence_snippet: The all-in-one visa package for internationals coming to Germany. Trusted by 250,000 users worldwide.

competitors_added.name: Edugo Abroad
competitors_added.reason: Discovered and verified via live website audit: Edugo Abroad operates as a study abroad consultancy and admissions platform, directly competing with MeetUniversity by offering student counseling, university application assistance, and visa processing services to students seeking international education.
competitors_added.evidence_snippet: As India’s Leading Study Visa Consultant, We Specialize In Guiding Students To The Best Universities And Courses In Europe
